topics.title: Plants
topics.description: Discover the world of plants around us!

lessons.title: Types of Plants
lessons.hook: Did you know plants come in many different sizes? Some are tiny, some are HUGE! 🌳
lessons.explanation: Plants can be very big or very small. We divide them into different groups based on their size and the type of stem they have. Let's explore!
lessons.content:
There are 5 main types of plants:

1. **Trees** - Very big and tall with hard, brown stems called trunks. They live for many years!
2. **Shrubs** - Medium-sized plants with strong woody stems
3. **Herbs** - Small plants with soft green stems
4. **Climbers** - Weak plants that need support to grow up
5. **Creepers** - Weak plants that grow along the ground

examples.description: Big, tall plants like neem, banyan, mango, and coconut trees
examples.visual: Tree with brown trunk and green leaves

examples.title: Herbs 🌱
examples.description: Small plants like spinach, mint, and coriander - some we eat!

examples.title: Climbers 🏃
examples.description: Weak plants that climb like money plant and grapevine

examples.title: Creepers 🎃
examples.description: Spread on ground like pumpkin and watermelon

lessons.title: Parts of a Plant
lessons.hook: Every plant is like a small factory with special parts that do different jobs! 🏭
lessons.explanation: Plants have many parts, and each part has an important job to help the plant grow and survive.
lessons.content:
The main parts of a plant are:

1. **Root** 📍 - Holds plant in soil, absorbs water and minerals
2. **Stem** 🌿 - Carries water and food to all parts, supports the plant
3. **Leaf** 🍃 - Makes food for the plant using air, water, and sunlight
4. **Flower** 💐 - Produces fruits and seeds
5. **Fruit** 🍎 - Contains seeds that grow into new plants

examples.title: Root - Underground Workers 📍
examples.description: Roots drink water from soil and keep plant standing tall
examples.food_example: Carrot, radish, turnip - we eat roots!

examples.title: Stem - The Delivery System 🌿
examples.description: Stems carry water from roots to leaves and food from leaves to roots

examples.title: Leaf - The Kitchen 🍃
examples.description: Leaves make food for plants using sunlight. It's like a plant's kitchen!

examples.title: Flower - The Fruit Maker 💐
examples.description: Flowers are beautiful and they make fruits and seeds

examples.title: Fruit - Seed Container 🍎
examples.description: Fruits protect seeds inside. When seeds fall, new plants grow!
examples.food_example: Apple, mango, cherry - we eat fruits!

lessons.title: Things We Get From Plants
lessons.hook: Plants give us SO many things we use every day! Let's discover them! 🎁
lessons.explanation: Plants are super useful! They give us food, clothes, medicine, and many other things we need.
lessons.content:
We get many important things from plants:

**Food**: Rice, wheat, vegetables, fruits, spices
**Clothes**: Cotton, jute, linen
**Medicine**: Tulsi, neem, clove
**Other things**: Wood, oil, rubber, paper, perfume, soap

Plants also give us oxygen to breathe!

questions.question: Which of these is a TREE?
questions.hint: Think of the biggest plants. Which one grows very tall and lives for many years?
questions.explanation: Neem is a tree! It's big, tall, and has a hard trunk. Mint is a herb, rose is a shrub, and pumpkin is a creeper.

questions.question: What does a ROOT do?
questions.hint: Roots are underground. What do they drink?
questions.explanation: Roots absorb water and minerals from the soil! They also hold the plant firmly in the ground.

questions.question: We eat the STEM of which plant?
questions.hint: Think about what you eat as a vegetable that grows underground but isn't a root.
questions.explanation: Potato is a stem! It grows underground and we eat it. A carrot is a root, spinach is a leaf, and apple is a fruit.

questions.question: Which plant needs a STICK to grow up?
questions.hint: Some plants have weak stems and need help to climb up.
questions.explanation: Money plant is a climber! It has a weak stem and uses a stick or wall to climb up. Pumpkin is a creeper that spreads on the ground.

questions.question: We wear clothes made from COTTON. Cotton comes from...
questions.hint: Cotton is a soft, fluffy fiber. It surrounds the seeds. What part of the plant has this?
questions.explanation: Cotton comes from the flower! The fluffy cotton fibers surround the seeds inside the flower. These are spun into thread to make clothes.

topics.title: Animals
topics.description: Learn about creatures big and small!

lessons.title: Types of Animals
lessons.hook: The world is full of amazing animals! Some walk, some fly, some swim! 🌍
lessons.explanation: Animals are living things that can move around. We can group them by what they eat or where they live.
lessons.content:
Main groups of animals:

1. **Wild Animals** - Live in forests, jungles, and deserts (lion, tiger, bear)
2. **Domestic Animals** - Live with humans (dog, cat, cow)
3. **Birds** - Have wings and can fly (parrot, crow, eagle)
4. **Water Animals** - Live in water (fish, dolphin, crocodile)
5. **Insects** - Tiny creatures with 6 legs (butterfly, bee, ant)

examples.title: Wild Animals 🦁
examples.description: Tiger, lion, elephant - live in nature

examples.title: Domestic Animals 🐕
examples.description: Dog, cat, cow - live with people

examples.title: Birds 🦅
examples.description: Parrot, crow, peacock - have feathers and wings

examples.title: Water Animals 🐠
examples.description: Fish, turtle, crocodile - live in water

lessons.title: Where Animals Live
lessons.hook: Different animals live in different places! Where would YOU find a fish? 🏜️
lessons.explanation: Animals live in homes called habitats. Each habitat has what the animal needs to survive.
lessons.content:
Different habitats:

1. **Forest** - Trees, shade, wet ground (monkeys, deer, birds)
2. **Desert** - Hot, dry, sandy (camel, snake, scorpion)
3. **Ocean** - Salt water (whale, shark, octopus)
4. **Pond/Lake** - Fresh water (frog, duck, fish)
5. **Mountain** - High, cold (eagle, snow leopard, yak)

examples.title: Forest Habitat 🌳
examples.description: Wet, shady with lots of trees

examples.title: Desert Habitat 🏜️
examples.description: Hot, dry with sand

examples.title: Ocean Habitat 🌊
examples.description: Deep salt water

questions.question: Which animal is a WILD animal?
questions.hint: Wild animals live in forests, not with people.
questions.explanation: Tiger is a wild animal! It lives in forests and jungles. Dog, cat, and cow live with people - they are domestic animals.

questions.question: Where do FISH live?
questions.hint: Think about where you see fish!
questions.explanation: Fish live in water! They need water to breathe and survive.

questions.question: Which animal would you find in a DESERT?
questions.hint: Deserts are hot and dry. Which animal can live without much water?
questions.explanation: Camels live in deserts! They can go without water for a long time and their feet are perfect for walking on sand.

questions.question: What do we call the place where an animal lives?
questions.hint: It's a special word for where wild animals live.
questions.explanation: Habitat is the home of a wild animal! It has everything the animal needs like food, water, and shelter.

questions.question: Which animal can live in BOTH water and on land?
questions.hint: It starts as a tadpole in water, then grows legs!
questions.explanation: Frogs live in both water and on land! Baby frogs (tadpoles) live in water with a tail. Adult frogs jump on land but need to stay near water.

topics.title: Food & Nutrition
topics.description: Discover the food we eat and why we need it!

lessons.title: Types of Food
lessons.hook: What's your favorite food? Every food helps your body in a special way! 🍽️
lessons.explanation: We eat different types of food. Each type helps our body in different ways.
lessons.content:
Main food groups:

1. **Fruits & Vegetables** 🥬 - Give us vitamins and energy (apple, carrot, spinach)
2. **Grains & Cereals** 🌾 - Give us energy (rice, wheat, bread)
3. **Protein Foods** 🥚 - Help our body grow (egg, milk, beans)
4. **Healthy Fats** 🥑 - Keep our body warm (nuts, oil)
5. **Sugars & Sweets** 🍪 - Give quick energy (but eat less of these!)

examples.title: Fruits & Vegetables 🥕
examples.description: Colorful and full of vitamins

examples.title: Grains 🌾
examples.description: Give us energy for running and playing

examples.title: Proteins 🥚
examples.description: Help our body grow strong

lessons.title: Why We Need Food
lessons.hook: Your body is like a machine! Food is the fuel that keeps it running! ⚡
lessons.explanation: Food gives our body energy and helps it grow, stay healthy, and fight sickness.
lessons.content:
Food helps us:

1. **Grow** - Our bones, muscles, and body need food to get bigger
2. **Get Energy** - We need energy to run, play, study, and think
3. **Stay Healthy** - Food keeps our skin, teeth, and eyes strong
4. **Fight Sickness** - Healthy food helps our body fight germs
5. **Repair** - When we get hurt, food helps our body heal

examples.title: For Growing 📏
examples.description: Milk, eggs, beans help us get taller

examples.title: For Energy ⚡
examples.description: Rice, bread, fruit give us power

examples.title: To Stay Healthy 💪
examples.description: Vegetables and fruits keep us strong

questions.question: Which food is a FRUIT?
questions.hint: Fruits grow on trees and are usually sweet!
questions.explanation: Apple is a fruit! It grows on trees and is full of vitamins. Rice, bread, and milk are other food types.

questions.question: Why do we need to eat food?
questions.hint: Food gives our body power!
questions.explanation: We eat food to get energy for running, playing, studying, and growing! Food keeps our body healthy and strong.

questions.question: Which food helps your body GROW strong?
questions.hint: What helps your bones and muscles grow?
questions.explanation: Milk and eggs have protein! Protein helps your body grow and become strong. Candy and sweets taste good but don't help you grow.

questions.question: Which is a HEALTHY lunch?
questions.hint: A healthy meal has different types of food.
questions.explanation: Rice, vegetables, and egg make a healthy meal! You get grains, vitamins, and protein all together.

questions.question: Your body is like a machine. What is food?
questions.hint: What makes a machine run? What makes your body run?
questions.explanation: Food is the fuel for your body! Just like a car needs fuel to run, your body needs food to have energy and grow.

lessons.title: Body Parts & Functions
lessons.hook: Your body has amazing parts that work together! Let's discover them! 🧠
lessons.explanation: Our body has many parts. Each part does a special job to keep us alive and healthy.
lessons.content:
Main body parts and what they do:

1. **Head** 🧠 - Contains brain (thinking) and eyes (seeing)
2. **Heart** ❤️ - Pumps blood around our body
3. **Lungs** 💨 - Help us breathe air
4. **Stomach** 🍽️ - Digests (breaks down) food
5. **Bones** 🦴 - Give our body shape and support
6. **Muscles** 💪 - Help us move and stay strong

examples.title: Brain 🧠
examples.description: Helps us think, remember, and make decisions

examples.title: Heart ❤️
examples.description: Pumps blood to every part of body

examples.title: Lungs 💨
examples.description: Help us breathe fresh air

examples.title: Bones 🦴
examples.description: Hold our body up and protect organs

lessons.title: Our Five Senses
lessons.hook: You can see, hear, smell, taste, and touch! These are your superpowers! 👀
lessons.explanation: We have five senses that help us understand the world around us.
lessons.content:
Our five senses:

1. **Sight** 👀 - Eyes let us see colors and shapes
2. **Hearing** 👂 - Ears let us hear sounds
3. **Smell** 👃 - Nose lets us smell things
4. **Taste** 👅 - Tongue lets us taste sweet, sour, salty, bitter
5. **Touch** ✋ - Skin lets us feel hot, cold, soft, hard

examples.title: Eyes See 👀
examples.description: Help us see colors, shapes, and people

examples.title: Ears Hear 👂
examples.description: Help us listen to music and voices

examples.title: Nose Smells 👃
examples.description: Help us smell flowers and food

questions.question: Which body part helps us THINK?
questions.hint: It's inside your head!
questions.explanation: Brain helps us think, remember, and make decisions! It's the smartest part of our body.

questions.question: Which sense helps you SEE?
questions.hint: You use this to watch TV and read books!
questions.explanation: Eyes help us see! They let us see colors, people, and everything around us.

questions.question: What does your HEART do?
questions.hint: It beats 'boom boom' inside your chest!
questions.explanation: Heart pumps blood to every part of your body! Blood carries oxygen and nutrients.

questions.question: Which sense helps you TASTE food?
questions.hint: It's the part of your mouth that helps you taste!
questions.explanation: Tongue helps us taste! It can taste sweet, sour, salty, and bitter flavors.

questions.question: Why do we need BONES?
options: To hold up body and protect organs 🦴
questions.hint: They give your body shape and structure!
questions.explanation: Bones hold up our body and give it shape! They also protect important organs like the heart and brain.

lessons.title: Personal Hygiene
lessons.hook: Keeping clean helps you stay healthy and strong! Let's learn good habits! 🧼
lessons.explanation: Good hygiene means keeping your body clean and healthy. This stops germs from making us sick.
lessons.content:
Important hygiene habits:

1. **Wash Hands** 🚰 - Before eating and after bathroom (kills germs)
2. **Brush Teeth** 🪥 - Twice a day to keep them strong
3. **Take Bath** 🚿 - Wash your whole body with soap
4. **Trim Nails** 💅 - Keep them short and clean
5. **Wash Hair** 💇 - Keep scalp clean and healthy

examples.description: Before eating and after toilet

examples.title: Brush Teeth 🪥

lessons.title: Safety Rules
lessons.hook: Playing safe keeps you from getting hurt! Learn these important rules! ⚠️
lessons.explanation: Safety rules help protect us from accidents and injuries.
lessons.content:
Important safety rules:

1. **Cross Roads Safely** 🚦 - Look both ways, hold adult's hand
2. **Don't Talk to Strangers** 🚫 - Stay close to trusted adults
3. **Wear Helmet** 🪖 - When riding bike or scooter
4. **Don't Play With Fire** 🔥 - Fire is dangerous!
5. **Wear Seat Belt** 🚗 - When in a car

examples.title: Road Safety 🚦
examples.description: Look left, right, left before crossing

examples.title: Wear Helmet 🪖
examples.description: Protects your head when cycling

examples.title: Fire Safety 🔥
examples.description: Never play with fire or matches

questions.question: When should you WASH your hands?
questions.hint: Think about germs on food!
questions.explanation: Wash hands before eating! This removes germs and keeps you healthy. Also wash after toilet and playing.

questions.question: How many times should you BRUSH teeth?
questions.hint: Morning and before sleep!
questions.explanation: Brush teeth twice a day - morning and before bed! This keeps your teeth strong and healthy.

questions.question: What should you do before CROSSING the road?
questions.hint: Check for cars coming!
questions.explanation: Look left, right, then left again before crossing! Hold an adult's hand and cross at zebra crossing.

questions.question: What should you wear when riding a bike?
questions.hint: It protects your head!
questions.explanation: Wear a helmet when riding bike or scooter! It protects your head if you fall.

questions.question: Why is hygiene important?
options: To kill germs and stay healthy 🧼
questions.hint: Think about what happens when you don't wash!
questions.explanation: Good hygiene kills germs and prevents sickness! It keeps your body clean and healthy.

lessons.title: Air We Breathe
lessons.hook: You breathe air every second, but can you see it? No! But it's everywhere! 💨
lessons.explanation: Air is all around us. We can't see it, but we need it to live.
lessons.content:
Facts about air:

1. **Invisible** - We can't see air, but it's everywhere
2. **We Breathe It** 💨 - Our lungs need oxygen from air
3. **Wind** 🌪️ - Moving air is called wind
4. **Has Weight** ⚖️ - Air has weight and pushes on us
5. **Plants Need It** 🌿 - Plants use air to make food

examples.title: We Breathe Air 💨
examples.description: In and out, all day and night

examples.title: Wind Moves Air 🌪️
examples.description: Moving air pushes things

examples.title: Air is Invisible 👻
examples.description: We can't see it but it's there

lessons.title: Water We Need
lessons.hook: Water is everywhere! In rain, rivers, ocean - and inside you! 💧
lessons.explanation: Water is essential for all life. We can see it and it has many forms.
lessons.content:
Facts about water:

1. **Essential** 💧 - We need water to survive
2. **States** 🌡️ - Ice (solid), Water (liquid), Steam (gas)
3. **Covers Earth** 🌊 - Most of Earth is water (oceans, rivers)
4. **In Our Body** 👤 - We are mostly water
5. **Rain** 🌧️ - Water falls from clouds as rain

examples.title: Water States 🌡️
examples.description: Ice cold, water liquid, steam hot

examples.title: Water Bodies 🌊
examples.description: Ocean, river, lake, pond

examples.title: Rain 🌧️
examples.description: Water falls from clouds

questions.question: Can you SEE air?
questions.hint: Think about looking at the sky!
questions.explanation: Air is invisible! We can't see it, but it's everywhere around us. We can only see what air moves (like leaves blowing).

questions.question: Why do we NEED water?
questions.hint: What happens if you don't drink water?
questions.explanation: We need water to survive! Water is in our body and keeps us healthy.

questions.question: What is moving AIR called?
questions.hint: When air moves, trees sway!
questions.explanation: Wind is moving air! When air moves fast, we call it wind. Wind can blow leaves and move things.

questions.question: Which is a STATE of water?
questions.hint: Water can be solid, liquid, or gas!
questions.explanation: Water has three states: Ice (solid, cold), Water (liquid, normal), Steam (gas, hot). Water changes between these states.

questions.question: Where does RAIN come from?
questions.hint: Look up when it rains!
questions.explanation: Rain comes from clouds! Water evaporates from oceans and rivers, forms clouds, and falls as rain.

lessons.title: Types of Transport
lessons.hook: We use different vehicles to travel from place to place! 🚗
lessons.explanation: Transport is how we move from one place to another. There are many types.
lessons.content:
Types of transport:

1. **Land Transport** 🚗 - Car, bus, train, bicycle
2. **Water Transport** 🚢 - Boat, ship, ferry
3. **Air Transport** ✈️ - Airplane, helicopter
4. **Public Transport** 🚌 - Buses, trains, metro for many people
5. **Personal Transport** 🚲 - Bicycle, scooter, personal car

examples.description: Travel on roads and rails

examples.title: Water Transport 🚢
examples.description: Travel on water

examples.title: Air Transport ✈️
examples.description: Travel in the sky

lessons.title: Ways to Communicate
lessons.hook: How do you talk to your friends and family? There are so many ways! 📱
lessons.explanation: Communication is how we share information and talk to each other.
lessons.content:
Ways to communicate:

1. **Face to Face** 👥 - Talk directly with people
2. **Phone** ☎️ - Call or text messages
3. **Letter** ✉️ - Written message sent by mail
4. **Internet** 💻 - Email, video call, chat
5. **Sign Language** 🙋 - Using hands to communicate

examples.title: Face to Face 👥
examples.description: Talk to people directly

examples.title: Phone & Text ☎️
examples.description: Call or message someone

examples.title: Letter ✉️
examples.description: Written message by mail

questions.question: Which is LAND transport?
questions.hint: It travels on roads!
questions.explanation: Bus is land transport! It travels on roads. Boat, ship are water transport. Airplane is air transport.

questions.question: Which is WATER transport?
questions.hint: It travels on water!
questions.explanation: Boat is water transport! It travels on water, rivers, and oceans.

questions.question: How do we COMMUNICATE over distance?
questions.hint: When someone is far away!
questions.explanation: Phone and internet help us communicate when we're far apart! We can call, text, or video chat.

questions.question: What is a PUBLIC transport?
questions.hint: Many people use it together!
questions.explanation: Public transport like bus and train carries many people! It's cheaper than using your own car.

questions.question: Which transport is fastest for long distance?
questions.hint: It travels through the sky!
questions.explanation: Airplane is fastest for long distances! It can travel across countries in a few hours.

lessons.title: Our Planet Earth
lessons.hook: We live on a planet called Earth! It's round and very special! 🌍
lessons.explanation: Earth is our home planet. It has everything we need to survive.
lessons.content:
Facts about Earth:

1. **Round Planet** 🌍 - Earth is a sphere
2. **Has Land & Water** 🏞️ - Continents, islands, and oceans
3. **Rotates** 🌪️ - Turns to create day and night
4. **Has Atmosphere** 💨 - Air around Earth protects us
5. **Has Life** 🌿 - Plants, animals, and people live here

examples.title: Earth is Round 🌍
examples.description: Like a big ball in space

examples.title: Land & Ocean 🌊
examples.description: Continents, mountains, and water

examples.title: Day & Night 🌙
examples.description: Earth rotates to create day and night

lessons.title: Space & Stars
lessons.hook: Beyond Earth is a huge space with stars, moon, and planets! 🌟
lessons.explanation: Space is everything beyond Earth. It's full of amazing things.
lessons.content:
Space includes:

1. **Sun** ☀️ - Star that gives us light and heat
2. **Moon** 🌙 - Orbits Earth, creates tides
3. **Stars** ⭐ - Distant suns very far away
4. **Planets** 🪐 - Orbit the sun (Mercury, Venus, Mars)
5. **Galaxy** 🌌 - Millions of stars together

examples.title: The Sun ☀️
examples.description: Gives us light and warmth

examples.title: The Moon 🌙
examples.description: Orbits Earth, lights night sky

examples.title: Stars ⭐
examples.description: Sparkle in night sky

questions.question: What is the shape of Earth?
questions.hint: Like a ball!
questions.explanation: Earth is round like a sphere! It's not flat. Astronauts can see it's round from space.

questions.question: What gives us LIGHT and HEAT?
questions.hint: It's bright during the day!
questions.explanation: Sun gives us light and heat! It's a star very close to Earth. Without sun, we couldn't survive.

questions.question: Why do we have DAY and NIGHT?
questions.hint: Earth is always spinning!
questions.explanation: Day and night happen because Earth rotates (spins)! When your place faces the sun = day. When it faces away = night.

questions.question: What is the MOON?
questions.hint: You see it at night!
questions.explanation: Moon orbits Earth! It's smaller than Earth and doesn't make its own light. It reflects light from the sun.

questions.question: What is a GALAXY?
questions.hint: Look at night sky with stars!
questions.explanation: Galaxy is millions or billions of stars together! Our sun is one star in the Milky Way galaxy.
